purpose: store built artifacts immutably with their provenance so that what is tested is exactly what is deployed
entry_criteria: Build produces a versioned artifact with a checksum
An artifact repository or registry is available
procedure: Publish each artifact once under an immutable version tied to the commit; forbid overwriting.
Record provenance: source commit, build run, builder, dependencies (SBOM) and checksum.
Restrict write access to the pipeline; give consumers read-only access.
Promote the same artifact through environments by reference to its digest, never by rebuilding.
Apply retention rules: keep released artifacts, expire snapshots, and never delete what production runs.
Scan and sign artifacts where supported, and verify the signature before deployment.
acceptance_criteria: An existing version cannot be overwritten
Provenance links the artifact to its commit and build
validation_method: Platform review of access and retention settings.

validation.command: docker manifest inspect registry.example.com/app:1.4.0 | sha256sum   # example
validation.expect: digest equals the one in the provenance record

validation.check: try to republish an existing version

failure_modes.detection: Same tag points to a different digest
failure_modes.response: Enforce immutability and deploy by digest

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The pipeline publishes app 1.4.0 with its digest, commit and SBOM. A later attempt to push another image under 1.4.0 is rejected, and staging and production both deploy the same digest.
